constraints.constraint: Use generated types directly from @/domains/control-sequence - NO manual Zod schema duplication
Node data only stores instance_id - parameters are fetched from API
Follow existing domain folder structure pattern (see building-semantics domain)
Follow CLAUDE.md coding standards - no comments unless explaining "why"
Use TypeScript strict mode with no any/unknown types
Use Jest with React Testing Library patterns

interface.name: ReheatInputsRequest
interface.signature: 17 input fields (9 required, 8 optional): zoneTemperature, coolingSetpoint, heatingSetpoint, dischargeAirTemperature, primaryAirflow, supplyAirTemperature, supplyAirTemperatureSetpoint, fanStatus, operationMode + optional co2, override fields

interface.name: ReheatOutputs
interface.signature: 14 output fields: damperPosition, valvePosition, airflowSetpoint, minOutdoorAirflow, adjAreaBreathingZoneFlow, adjPopBreathingZoneFlow, flowSensorAlarm, heatingValveRequest, hotWaterPlantRequest, leakingDamperAlarm, leakingValveAlarm, lowFlowAlarm, lowTempAlarm, zonePressureRequest, zoneTempRequest

tests.standards: Designer uses Jest with React Testing Library. Tests are co-located with source files using .spec.ts/.spec.tsx naming convention. Follow TDD approach: write failing test first, then implement. Test behavior, not implementation details. All 542 existing tests must continue to pass.
